name: dashboard-grid
title: Dashboard grid
description: A 12-column grid for dashboard widgets: sizes by name, rows of one fixed height so tall and short widgets line up, and one column on a phone.
docs: It lays out and nothing else, and it needs no client code. Breakpoints follow the grid's own width (container queries), so it adapts beside a sidebar: twelve columns from 896px, six from 672px, one below. Give every Widget a `label`: each becomes a region. A widget's only child fills it. Row spans apply from the tablet layout up; on a phone a widget is as tall as its content. With `dense` the visual order can differ from the DOM order.
